description: Correct owned/operator-granted selected articles only; read revision, html and text_nodes first. Plain title/description: {ru/en:text}; plain TEXT parts: [{id,title:{ru/en:text},text:{ru/en:text}}]. Rich HTML must use description_replacements:{ru/en:[{old,new}]} or parts:[{id,replacements:{ru/en:[{old,new}]}}]. Each old must match one text-node occurrence; new is escaped plain text, preserving all HTML tags/links/images. Supply revision from get. Original author, slugs, media, tags, publication state stay unchanged; no global pages. Published corrections become public immediately: confirm wording before calling.
name: online_article_update
